name: bumble:live
description: Login-gated sidecar app for the bumbleflies live show: permanent VDO.Ninja room links and the matching OBS scene-collection download. Members manage the room; show guests join via personal access links.

access.public: Landing + Google sign-in + access-link entry at / (no API calls, no secrets)
access.guest: Personal hash link #r=…&p=…&person=X — camera window, scene monitor, director control; no management
access.member: bumbleflies Google accounts — guest-link creation, rotate, scene collection

room.persistence: Permanent links; OBS imported once ever
room.rotate: POST /api/room/rotate revokes every previously sent link
room.sceneCollection: POST /api/scene-collection downloads the patched 8-scene OBS file
